text:
Salutations cargo team,
Before opening, our lead trainer brought up a thought on clear signage

I am sharing this from the Companion Animal Travel Desk because our handoff notes need to stay easy to follow for everyone who touches companion bookings. We have been doing well at answering family concerns in a calm way, and I want us to keep that tone steady when we log service changes in the desk ledger. Clear, consistent notes help the team protect the traveler and the animal, and they also reduce avoidable calls back to customers.

On the quarantine side, please keep the room record visible and current. <<FACT F027>> When a traveler asks about kennel placement or transfer steps, give a direct answer in plain language and avoid adding extra detail that could confuse the handoff. If a pet has a special handling note, write it in full and make sure the next staff member can act on it without guessing. That kind of clarity supports dependable companion travel and helps us hold the line on service quality.

Please also keep an eye on signage near the work area. If labels are faded, if a carrier tag is loose, or if a notice no longer matches the current process, flag it right away so we can correct it before the next arrival. The goal is simple: fewer surprises for customers, fewer delays for staff, and a safer path for every pet in our care. Thanks for staying attentive and for keeping Aurelia Skyways steady at the counter and behind the scenes.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
